about_the_game:
About the game
Parking in Tight Spaces is a fun, tricky game where you park trucks, buses, and other vehicles in tight spots, It’s all about smooth moves and sharp turns. Vehicles can attach a trailers or even other vehicles. Brought to life by two indie devs.

Gameplay 
The game has a level structure. Each level is a riddle. Solve it and you will unlock the next one. Each new level is more difficult than the previous one. If you pass it without collisions and in the allotted time you will get more points. Compete with other players in the leaderboard.

short_description: A game with a budget of two beers and a sandwich. Test your skills in this relaxing parking game! Park cars, trailers, and buses in tight spaces. Each level pushes your precision and control - can you master every tricky spot?
